verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's marketing pages emphasize a 'full Ubuntu archive for packages and updates,' broad IDE/AI-ML tooling support, and WSL integration, implying a rich package ecosystem, but no evidence describes an actual single command (e.g., a meta-package or setup script) that installs a complete developer toolchain in one step. missing for 10: a concrete single-command install example (e.g., apt install build-essential/ubuntu-dev-tools or similar), independent hands-on confirmation of a one-command full dev environment setup.
